## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The AGENTS.md pre-push instruction still names the removed `make test` target and should be updated, because the guide says the repository has no CI and that command is the only test run a change gets.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README's test instruction to match. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each file and the Makefile targets.

## Important

The Layout line this pull request adds at `AGENTS.md:10` names `check`, so the guide contradicts itself. — A contributor or agent following the guide gets a make error instead of the pre-push test run, in a repository the guide says has no CI. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to read `make check`.
